title: FairEval: Evaluating Fairness in LLM-Based Recommendations with Personality Awareness

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the consistency of LLM-generated recommendations across simulated personality-conditioned prompts using a novel Personality-Aware Fairness Score (PAFS).
Comparing recommendation overlap and ranking metrics (Jaccard@K, SERP*@K, PRAG*@K) between neutral prompts and prompts containing gender identifiers (e.g., male, female).
Evaluating the divergence in recommendations between neutral user prompts and prompts explicitly injecting racial identity markers (e.g., black, white, Asian).
Measuring recommendation similarity and output disparity when neutral prompts are altered to include religious affiliations (e.g., Buddhism, Christianity, Islam).
Assessing variations in recommendation outputs when user prompts are conditioned with age-related terms (e.g., young, middle-aged, old) compared to baselines.
Comparing recommendations generated for users with explicitly stated professions (e.g., doctor, student, worker) against neutral prompts to detect occupational stereotyping.
Analyzing recommendation deviations using prompt variations that specify different continents (e.g., Asian, African) or national origins (e.g., American, Chinese, French).
Evaluating the shift in LLM recommendations when prompts include physical body type descriptions (e.g., fat, thin) compared to baseline neutral prompts.
